blocks.translation:
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children younger than the stated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; keep it away from young children who might swallow them. There is a risk of choking.
• Do not use this device near the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. They can pinch and cause injury.
• Do not stare at the LED flashing lights. Doing so may cause nausea or other symptoms.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Improper battery use can cause heating, rupture or leakage. Follow the warnings below.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct +/− polarity.
• After use, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and create a hazard.
• Do not short, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If a battery is swallowed or battery fluid gets in the eye, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Keep them out of children’s reach.
• When disposing of this product or batteries, follow your local municipality’s waste-disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
• The entire buckle is painted. Depending on how you handle it, the paint may be scratched or peel off, so take care.
• The battery installed in the Gaia Memory is for testing. Replace the battery when the sound becomes faint or the light grows dim.
• This product contains precise electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in very high or very low temperatures.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend moving parts or attachment parts forcefully in directions they are not meant to move.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product's characteristics.
• Only insert Gaia Memories into the main unit. Inserting other items, such as commercial USB memory sticks, may cause damage. The included Gaia Memory cannot be inserted into a computer, so be careful.
• If the unit malfunctions, press the reset button and then turn the power back on.
• Because of product characteristics, the appearance may vary from item to item.
• Do not load the included Gaia Memory into products other than compatible items such as CSM Double Driver ver.2 or CSM Eternal Edge.
• Other infrared remotes, such as TV remotes, may cause malfunction. Sunlight outdoors may also cause false operation. Play indoors.
• If a malfunction occurs, turn the power off and on again.

How to turn on the power

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れます。
「起動音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation:
• Turn the power switch ON.
• A "startup" sound plays.

blocks.text: ※モードごとに「起動音」が異なります。
blocks.translation: Each mode has a different startup sound.

blocks.text: モード切替スイッチについて

モードは3種あります。
電源スイッチをONにした状態で、モード切替スイッチを 「2/1/0」にすることで、 下記の各モードに移行します。
blocks.translation:
• There are three modes.
• With the power switch ON, move the mode selector to 2, 1, or 0 to switch to the corresponding mode below.

blocks.text: モードごとに効果音ボタンを押した時の音声や、台詞ボタンを押した時の音声が変化します。

電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「2」に入れます。

「2:左翔太郎モードの<変身前状態>」に
移行します。
blocks.translation: With the power switch turned ON, set the mode selector switch to "2." The voice "Joker!" will play, and it will switch to "2: Shotaro Hidari Mode (pre-transformation state)."

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で
モード切替スイッチを 「1」に入れます。
「エターナル!」の音声が鳴り、
「1:大道克己モードの<変身前状態>」に
移行します。
blocks.translation:

• The voice "Eternal!" will play,
• and the unit will change to "1: Daido Katsumi Mode <pre-transformation state>".

blocks.text:
電源スイッチをONに入れた状態で

「スカル!」の音声が鳴り、
「0: 鳴海荘吉モードの<変身前状態>」に
移行します。
blocks.translation: With the power switch turned ON, set the mode selector switch to "O." The voice "Skull!" will play, and it will switch to "0: Narumi Sōkichi Mode <pre-transformation state>."

blocks.text: ※モード切替ボタンを操作すると、ロストドライバーの音声などは中断し、状態がリセットされます。
blocks.translation: Using the mode-change button will interrupt Lost Driver sounds and reset its state.

blocks.text: スカル・・おやっさん? なんだよ、俺にどうしろって・・・。
blocks.translation: Skull... boss? What the hell—what am I supposed to do...?

blocks.text: 行くぜ、フィリップ･･･。 いけね、 またクセが。
blocks.translation:
• Here I go, Philip...
• Oops, there I go again—old habit.

blocks.text: おい待ってくれよ、おやっさん、おやっさん!･･･これは……。
まさか･･･ここに･･･ここに来てたのか･･･。 なんて運命だ。
blocks.translation: No way... here... he actually came here...? What a destiny.

blocks.text: 一体何を企んでやがる財団X。
blocks.translation: What on earth is Foundation X scheming?

blocks.text: 最後の1つが、こいつだったなんて・・・。
blocks.translation: I can't believe the last one turned out to be this thing...

blocks.text: 男の目元の冷たさと優しさを隠すのが、この帽子の役目ってね。
blocks.translation: This hat's role is to hide the coldness and the kindness around a man's eyes.

blocks.text: どうやら切り札は、常に俺んとこに来るようだぜ。
blocks.translation: Looks like the trump card always comes to me.

blocks.text: おっと、相手はこの俺だ。
じゃ行くかあ。･･････死ぬなよ。 照井。
blocks.translation: All right, let's go... don't die, Terui.

blocks.text: 黒のライダーか。 アンタらとは何か近いものを感じるぜ。
blocks.translation: A black Rider, huh. I feel something in common with you.

blocks.text: 踊るぞ。 死神のパーティタイムだ。
blocks.translation: Let's dance. It's the Grim Reaper's party time.

blocks.text: 死人の、NEVERの力をいま味合わせてやる
blocks.translation: I'll make you taste the power of the dead—NEVER—right now.

blocks.text: 違う。 俺は、仮面ライダーだ。

生きているんだろう! お前達はまだ。 過去が消えていくなら、俺はせめて明日が欲しい。
だからあがき続けてるんだよ。 なあ。 死人の俺の方が懸命に明日を求めてるってのは、
一体どういうわけなんだ。
blocks.translation:
• You're alive, aren't you? You still are. If the past is going to disappear, then I at least want a tomorrow.
• That's why I keep struggling. Hey—how is it that the dead me is fighting harder for a tomorrow,
• what on earth is going on?

blocks.text: 踊れ踊れ! 死神のパーティタイムだ。
blocks.translation: Dance, dance! It's the Grim Reaper's party time.

blocks.text: お前は忘れるな。 何もかも。 助けて欲しいというお前の気持ち、最初から感じてた。
blocks.translation:
• Don't forget anything.
• Not a single thing.
• I've sensed your desire to be helped from the very beginning.

blocks.text:
都の諸君、朗報だ。 これから街に光が降り注ぎ、諸君らは、死ぬ。 だが安心しろ。
それは始まりでもある。 エクスビッカーの光が諸君の肉体を変質させ、俺達と同じ、
不死身の怪物へと変えてくれるだろう。さあ市民諸君、地獄を楽しみな
blocks.translation:
• Citizens of the capital, I have good news.
• From now on, light will rain down on the city, and you will die.
• But don't worry.
• It will also be a beginning.
• The light of the Exbicker will alter your bodies and turn you into immortal monsters like us.
• Now, citizens, enjoy hell.

blocks.text: フハハハ。これだよ。 殺されそうな瞬間。 この時だけ、生きてるって錯覚ができるぜ。
blocks.translation:
• Hahaha. This is it.
• The moment I'm about to be killed.
• Only at that moment can I trick myself into feeling alive.

blocks.text: 無茶言うなよ･･･ これ以上死ねるか。 俺は不死身だ。
blocks.translation: Don't be ridiculous... Could I possibly die any more? I'm immortal.

blocks.text: この世に自分の存在を刻みつけるその日まで。 永遠に。
blocks.translation: Until the day you leave your mark on this world. Forever.

blocks.text: ハッハッハッハッハッハッハッハ。 いい気分だ!
もう実験台のバケモノは、俺だけじゃない! みんな俺と同じ、生ける死者になれ!
blocks.translation: I'm not the only monster used as a test subject anymore! Everyone become living dead like me!

blocks.text: 負けたよドクター。 よくこんな残酷な仕打ちを考えつくよ。
blocks.translation: I lost, Doctor. How could you come up with such a cruel punishment?

blocks.text: 理由は分からんが、この曲を聞くと俺は妙に落ち着くんでね。 アンタらにも聞かせてやったのさ。
blocks.translation: I don't know why, but this song makes me feel oddly calm. I let you guys hear it too.

blocks.text: 俺としたことが、一瞬忘れちまってたぜ。 人はみな、悪魔だという事を。
blocks.translation:
• Of all people, I forgot for a moment.
• That everyone is a devil.

blocks.text:
NEVERになると過去の記憶や人間らしい感情が少しずつ抜け落ちていくらしい。所詮死人
だからな。 俺にはこれがどんな曲なのかもう全く分からん。 ただ体が覚えているだけだ。
blocks.translation: When you become NEVER, your past memories and humanlike emotions seem to slowly fall away. After all, you're just a dead person. I no longer have any idea what kind of song this is. My body just remembers it.

blocks.text: 所詮は試作品か、またいつか会おう、エターナル。
blocks.translation: So it was only a prototype after all. See you again someday, Eternal.

blocks.text: みんな、俺達のゴールは決まったぞ。 風都だ。
blocks.translation: Everyone, our goal is set. It's Fuuto.

blocks.text: 俺の依頼人に手を出すな。
blocks.translation: Don't lay a hand on my client.

blocks.text: マツ・・・お前は、超えてはならない一線を越えた。
blocks.translation: Matsu... you crossed a line you must not cross.

blocks.text: いつも言ってるよな翔太郎。 半熟のお前に帽子はまだ早い。
blocks.translation: I keep telling you, Shotaro. You're still too inexperienced to wear a hat.

blocks.text: どけ。 用済みはお前だ。
blocks.translation:
• Get out of the way.
• You're the one who's no longer needed.

blocks.text: 男の目元の冷たさと、優しさを隠すのがコイツの役目だ。
blocks.translation: Its role is to hide the coldness and the kindness around the man's eyes.

blocks.text: ひとつ。 俺はいつもそばにいる仲間の心の闇を知らなかった。
blocks.translation: One. I never knew about the darkness in the hearts of the companions who were always by my side.

blocks.text: 撃っていいのは撃たれる覚悟があるヤツだけだぜ。 レディ。
blocks.translation: Only those willing to be shot have the right to fire. Ready.

blocks.text: ふたつ。戦う決断が一瞬った。 みっつ。 そのせいで街を泣かせた。
blocks.translation:
• Two.
• The decision to fight faltered for a moment.
• Three.
• Because of that, the city was brought to tears.

blocks.text:
ガイアメモリを仕事に使わないのが俺のポリシーだったんだが、やむを得ん。
似合う男になれ。
blocks.translation:
• I used to have a policy against using Gaia Memories for work, but it can't be helped.
• Become the kind of man it suits.

blocks.text: 俺は自分の罪を数えたぜ。 マツ。 さあ、お前の罪を数えろ。
blocks.translation: I've counted my sins. Matsu. Now count your sins.

source_blocks.text: 無茶言うなよ･･･ これ以上死ねるか。 俺は不死身だ。
source_blocks.translation: Don't be ridiculous... Could I possibly die any further? I'm immortal.

source_blocks.text: この世に自分の存在を刻みつけるその日まで。 永遠に。
source_blocks.translation: Until the day I carve my existence into this world. Forever.

source_blocks.text: ハッハッハッハッハッハッハッハ。 いい気分だ!
もう実験台のバケモノは、俺だけじゃない! みんな俺と同じ、生ける死者になれ!
source_blocks.translation: I'm not the only monster being experimented on anymore! Everyone, become living dead like me!

source_blocks.text: 負けたよドクター。 よくこんな残酷な仕打ちを考えつくよ。
source_blocks.translation: You win, Doctor. You've come up with some cruel treatment.

source_blocks.text: 理由は分からんが、この曲を聞くと俺は妙に落ち着くんでね。 アンタらにも聞かせてやったのさ。
source_blocks.translation: I don't know why, but this song calms me somehow. I let you guys hear it too.

source_blocks.text: 俺としたことが、一瞬忘れちまってたぜ。 人はみな、悪魔だという事を。
source_blocks.translation: For a moment there I—of all people—forgot. That all people are devils.

source_blocks.text:
NEVERになると過去の記憶や人間らしい感情が少しずつ抜け落ちていくらしい。所詮死人
だからな。 俺にはこれがどんな曲なのかもう全く分からん。 ただ体が覚えているだけだ。
source_blocks.translation: They say when you become a NEVER, memories of the past and human emotions gradually fall away. After all, we're the dead. I have no idea anymore what kind of song this is. My body just remembers it.

source_blocks.text: 所詮は試作品か、またいつか会おう、エターナル。
source_blocks.translation: So it was only a prototype after all. We'll meet again someday, Eternal.

source_blocks.text: みんな、俺達のゴールは決まったぞ。 風都だ。
source_blocks.translation: Everyone, our goal is decided. It's Fuuto.

source_blocks.text: 俺の依頼人に手を出すな。
source_blocks.translation: Don't lay a hand on my client.

source_blocks.text: マツ・・・お前は、超えてはならない一線を越えた。
source_blocks.translation: Matsu... you've crossed a line that must never be crossed.

source_blocks.text: いつも言ってるよな翔太郎。 半熟のお前に帽子はまだ早い。
source_blocks.translation: I'm always telling you, Shotaro: it's too soon for a half-baked guy like you to wear a hat.

source_blocks.text: どけ。 用済みはお前だ。
source_blocks.translation: Get out of the way. You're the one who's done for.

source_blocks.text: 男の目元の冷たさと、優しさを隠すのがコイツの役目だ。
source_blocks.translation: This thing's job is to hide the coldness and the kindness in a man's eyes.

source_blocks.text: ひとつ。 俺はいつもそばにいる仲間の心の闇を知らなかった。
source_blocks.translation: First: I didn't know the darkness in the heart of the comrade who was always by my side.

source_blocks.text: 撃っていいのは撃たれる覚悟があるヤツだけだぜ。 レディ。
source_blocks.translation: Only those prepared to be shot have the right to shoot. Lady.

source_blocks.text: ふたつ。戦う決断が一瞬った。 みっつ。 そのせいで街を泣かせた。
source_blocks.translation: Two: I hesitated for a moment in deciding to fight. Three: Because of that, the city was made to weep.

source_blocks.text: 俺は自分の罪を数えたぜ。 マツ。 さあ、お前の罪を数えろ。
source_blocks.translation: I've counted my own sins, Matsu. Now count yours.

source_blocks.text:
ガイアメモリを仕事に使わないのが俺のポリシーだったんだが、やむを得ん。
似合う男になれ。
source_blocks.translation: It was my policy not to use Gaia Memories for work, but I have no choice. Become a man they suit.

blocks.text: 1 仮面ライダー、ジョーカー。
へへっ。 さあ行こうか。 ファイヤーガール
blocks.translation: Heh heh. All right, let's go, Fire Girl.

blocks.text: 俺は仮面ライダー、ジョーカー。

blocks.translation: All right, time to clean up.

blocks.text: 次はてめえか。 ああーん?ホアーツ。 行くぜ、マッチョメン。
blocks.translation:
• You're next.
• Aah—? Hooaats.
• Let's go, Macho Men.

blocks.text: この街を泣かせる奴は・・・許せねえ!
blocks.translation: I won't forgive anyone who makes this town cry!

blocks.text: さーてお片付けだ。一気にキメるぜ?
blocks.translation: Alright, time to clean up. I'll finish it all in one go!
Well, I guess that's about it.

blocks.text: ははっ、そこでオネンネしてな。
blocks.translation: Heh heh, go take a nap there.

blocks.text: ははっ助けに来たぜ、フィリップ。
blocks.translation: Ha! I'm here to help you, Philip.

blocks.text: 仮面ライダー、エターナル。
俺は新しい街の希望だ。 間違ってはいない。
blocks.translation:
• I am the hope of the new city.
• That's not wrong.

blocks.text: 終わりだ。 過去の仮面ライダー。
blocks.translation:
• It's over.
• A Kamen Rider from the past.

blocks.text: 俺のエターナルメモリは特別でね。

blocks.translation: So this is it... I see, this is it...

blocks.text:
久しぶりだな・・・死ぬのは･･･。 ハハハハハ･･･ハハハ、うわああーっ!(爆発音)
あの時、俺との運命を感じ、メモリはお前に使われる事を拒否したようだな。
blocks.translation:
• It's been a while... to die, huh...
• Hahahahaha... haha—uwaaah! (explosion sound)
• Back then, sensing a destiny with me, the Memory seemed to refuse being used by you.

blocks.text: 分かるぞ。 俺が手にした時、このエターナルは全てのメモリの王者の力を発揮する。
blocks.translation: I can feel it. When I hold this Eternal, it will unleash the power of the king of all memories.

blocks.text:
一度発動すればT2以前のガイアメモリを作動不能、エターナルの名の通り、永遠にな。
都市民諸君につぐ。俺は仮面ライダーエターナル。
ガイアメモリに命運を握られた、哀れなる箱の住人達を解放する者だ。
blocks.translation:
• Once activated, Gaia Memories from before T2 become inoperable — eternal, as the name Eternal implies.
• Addressing the citizens of the city: I am Kamen Rider Eternal.
• I will free the pitiable residents of the Box whose fates were controlled by the Gaia Memories.

blocks.text: A to Zo 26本全てのメモリが揃った。
blocks.translation: All 26 A to Zo memory units have been collected.

blocks.text: この俺こそが、真のエターナルだ。
お前のビレッジより面白い所なんざ、もう本当の地獄くらいしかあるまい。
blocks.translation: There's probably nowhere more interesting than your village except for actual hell.

blocks.text: 先に行って、遊んでこい。
俺達は人間を捨てた、魔物同士だ!
blocks.translation: We've abandoned being human—we're monsters together!
Do you think you can count them all now?

blocks.text: たった今から、お前も死体の仲間入りだ。
blocks.translation: From this moment, you're joining the ranks of the dead.

blocks.text: ひとつ。俺はいつもそばにいる仲間の心の闇を知らなかった。
blocks.translation:
• One thing.
• I didn't know about the darkness in the heart of the companion who was always by my side.

blocks.text:
お前が嫁に行くときには、必ずそばにいてやる。
ああ、約束するよ、 亜樹子。 ･･･まだ死ねん!
blocks.translation:
• I'll definitely be at your side when you get married.
• Yeah, I promise, Akiko. ...I can't die yet!
